claims.joined_saved_paragraph: Reading then gives an explicit self-directed question. Mashiro says she once equated seniors with justice and Gehenna with evil, and says her view has changed while continuing to trust the seniors. The difficult book does not provide the answer she wants. Asked what she wants, she chooses to seek a way to save everyone outside the dilemma's imposed restrictions. The ambition is real, as is the pleasure of reading together; an executable rescue technique, appointment as future leader and completed renunciation of every school hostility are not shown. This is local ethical inquiry, not a completed institutional reform. [P01:20003:003]
